name: Joshua
source:
Priest at the church who Amelia depends upon.
Since they were children, Amelia and him were raised like siblings.
He holds unpleasant feelings towards the Mafia. It seems there's some kind of reason for that but...
[spoiler]Bad End Only in PS2 version[/spoiler]
